description: This file defines the ParameterListTableModel class, which extends AbstractTableModel to manage a table of LoggerData parameters for a GUI component. It includes methods for adding, selecting, and clearing parameters, and handles table cell editing and data display. The class interacts with a DataRegistrationBroker to register/deregister LoggerData instances for logging.

classes.name: ParameterListTableModel
classes.description: A table model for displaying and managing LoggerData parameters in a GUI table, supporting selection, addition, and clearing of parameters.

methods.name: ParameterListTableModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the table model with a DataRegistrationBroker and data type string.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows based on parameter entries.

methods.description: Returns the fixed number of columns in the table.
